title: Flight Simulator 2020 - POI's - France -Château de Quéribus
description:
In this video we will fly over the Château de Quéribus . The Château de Quéribus (in Occitan Castèl de Queribús) is a ruined castle in the commune of Cucugnan in the Aude département of France. It has been listed as a monument historique by the French Ministry of Culture since 1907
